method: Inspect all ordered fresh still contact sheets and selected native-resolution frames. Numeric qualification is separate.

groups.observations: Foundation repeats visually agree. Baseline near sandstone/limestone/marble preserve stepped bands; wide scenes retain distant silhouettes and fog. Existing wide limestone water glare is strong. Candidate comparison remains pending.

Baseline marble noon, quartzite near/rain and basalt near/dusk preserve layered terrain, distinct bright/dark materials and fog rolloff. Hewn sandstone retains masonry joints and a bright sunlit face. Candidate comparison pending.

Baseline hewn limestone and both settled dawn scenes retain their layers, aperture-free hillside and fog. Candidate sandstone near/wide and limestone near match baseline geometry, material boundaries and lighting; no new missing terrain visible.

Candidate limestone dusk, marble rain/noon, quartzite near/rain and basalt near preserve matching baseline layers, silhouettes, material contrast and fog. Strong limestone water highlight also occurs in baseline. Cosmetic creatures vary; static geometry remains intact.

Candidate basalt dusk, hewn sandstone/limestone and both dawn scenes preserve matching baseline bands, material seams, lake boundary and fog. Cosmetic creatures differ in dawn scenes. Sealed geode context retains an intact host wall.

Primary geode aperture/hero retain a continuous shell passage, purple lining and dark core; reload keeps the opening. Closeout sandstone near/wide and limestone near reproduce the primary bands and material boundaries.

Closeout limestone dusk, marble rain/noon, quartzite near/rain and basalt near retain matching primary bands, steps and fog. Water glint remains consistently bright in the limestone scene; no new missing geometry visible.
Closeout basalt dusk and hewn sandstone/limestone preserve primary silhouettes, masonry seams and natural rock transitions. Existing sunlit-face and water highlights agree across phases.

Both closeout dawn scenes preserve layered relief and fog. The four closeout geode views retain the intact sealed wall, continuous opened shell/lining/core and reload aperture, matching the primary views. No new missing wall visible.

native_resolution.observations: Continuous shell walls, purple flecked lining and a distinct dark central material remain visible at native resolution; no missing-chunk boundary.
Torch-lit walls retain their shadow shape and continuous shell, lining and core. Positive lighting appears preserved; independent material metrics remain required.
